visualBrief.primarySubject: the most concrete physical subject, event, organization, or action explicitly described by the story
visualBrief.scene: A commissioned technology-publication photograph of that concrete subject or event, not a category-level representation.
supportingElements: only contextual elements that directly explain the story
visualBrief.composition: One hero subject with one or two supporting elements, natural editorial lighting and strong negative space.
avoid: glowing holograms, floating code, HUDs and neon sci-fi effects
prominent readable text or fake headlines
